def normalize(cells):
    min_r = min(r for r,c in cells)
    min_c = min(c for r,c in cells)
    normalized = frozenset((r-min_r, c-min_c) for r,c in cells)
    return normalized

def rotations(cells):
    variants = set()
    current = list(cells)
    for _ in range(4):
        n = normalize(current)
        variants.add(n)
        current = [(-c, r) for r,c in current]
    # also reflections
    reflected = [(-r, c) for r,c in list(cells)]
    for _ in range(4):
        n = normalize(reflected)
        variants.add(n)
        reflected = [(-c, r) for r,c in reflected]
    return variants
